description: Hand one blocked step to your human: a CAPTCHA, a 2FA/OTP code, an approval, or a sign-in your agent should not do alone. Pro acts: sends your person a one-tap link (to notify_webhook, Slack/Discord-compatible, and/or notify_email), returns request_id, and later an HMAC-signed POST to callback_url when they answer. Free watch-only logs a would_request for the weekly stuck report and sends nothing. We never solve CAPTCHAs and never ask for passwords.

agent.description: Your agent's name, shown to the person.

callback_url.description: Pro: public https URL we POST the answer to, signed with X-Relay-Signature = hex HMAC-SHA256(callback_secret, timestamp + "." + body).

kind.description: captcha (person solves it in their browser), 2fa_code (person pastes the code; you read it once), approve (yes/no), login (person signs in, then taps done).

notify_email.description: Pro: email address to send the one-tap link to.

notify_webhook.description: Pro: public https URL we POST {text, human_url} to (Slack/Discord incoming webhooks work).

step.description: One plain sentence for the person, e.g. "Paste the 6-digit code GitHub just texted you".

timeout_minutes.description: How long the person has, 1-1440. Default 30.

url.description: The page the person should open, if any (https).

name: request_human
